flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Platform defaults, rollout percentages and per-tenant overrides. Every change needs a reason and is audited.
flags.rolloutHint: Share of tenants that get the flag when it is off by default

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.description: Values every customer starts from. A change is a new version with an effective date and a reason; customers may override where noted.

storage_free_gb.name: Free storage per customer type
storage_free_gb.help: Storage every customer gets without paying, by customer type.

storage_price_per_gb_month.name: Price of extra storage
storage_price_per_gb_month.help: Monthly price per GB above the free allowance; empty means it is not sold to that type yet.

storage_notice_at_percent.name: Storage notices
storage_notice_at_percent.help: Usage levels at which the customer is told their storage is filling up.

storage_record_bytes.name: Size counted per record
storage_record_bytes.help: Bytes counted towards storage for each record, by document kind.

subscription_trial_days.name: Trial length
subscription_trial_days.help: How long a new subscription is free before it becomes active.

subscription_invoice_due_days.name: Invoice payment term
subscription_invoice_due_days.help: Days from issuing a platform invoice to its due date.

support_grant_max_hours.name: Longest support grant
support_grant_max_hours.help: The longest window an owner can approve for support to read their data.

reminders_schedule.name: Payment reminders
reminders_schedule.help: Days after the due date (and grace) when residents get a LINE reminder.

notifications_quiet_hours.name: Quiet hours
notifications_quiet_hours.help: No non-urgent messages to residents in these hours (Bangkok time).

ai_usage_metering.name: Bill AI beyond the allowance
ai_usage_metering.help: Charge OCR use above what the plan includes.

compliance_tariff_cap_severity.name: Rate above the utility tariff
compliance_tariff_cap_severity.help: How a utility rate above the published tariff is treated.

payments_duplicate_window_hours.name: Duplicate payment window
payments_duplicate_window_hours.help: A QR callback or bank row of the same amount as a slip from the same payer and unit within this window is held as a possible duplicate.

etax_enabled.name: e-Tax submission
etax_enabled.help: Submit receipts of VAT-registered customers to their e-Tax provider (opt-in).

analytics_reminder_effective_days.name: Reminder effect window
analytics_reminder_effective_days.help: A payment within this many days of a reminder counts as an effect of the reminder.

tm30_notify_within_hours.name: TM30 notice deadline
tm30_notify_within_hours.help: Hours within which a foreigner's stay must be reported to Immigration.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.description: Templates of every notification by key, channel and audience. Drafts are previewed with sample data, sent to yourself as a test and published as a new version.
templates.newVersionHint: Starts from the newest version. The draft changes nothing until it is published.
templates.subject: Subject
templates.sampleDataHint: The variables used for the preview
templates.invalidJson: Sample data is not valid JSON
templates.publishBody: Every new {language} message of this template uses this version from now on.
templates.testSendBody: The published version goes to you only, over {channel}, with the sample data.

guides.title: Guides
guides.description: Articles of the public site in Thai and English. Write a draft; another person reviews it before it is published.
guides.reviewHint: The last editor cannot publish. Another platform user checks the facts and sources, then publishes.

field.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and -, e.g. rental-income-tax; the same in both languages
field.title: Title
field.summaryHint: Up to 200 characters; shown in search results
field.answerHint: Answer the article's question in 2–3 sentences, up to 600 characters
field.generalLabel: Legal or tax article (shows that it is general information, not advice)
field.audience: The closing call to action speaks to
field.reviewedHint: The day the facts were last checked against the sources
field.sectionsHint: A list of sections, each with id, heading and blocks; a block is p (paragraph), ul / ol (list), note (an aside with tone info, warning or product) or affiliate
field.faq: FAQ (JSON: a list of q and a)
field.sources: Sources (JSON: a list of label and url, https links only)

guides.newHint: Saved as a draft first; add the body on the guide's page.
guides.editLive: This guide is published: the change shows on the site within 5 minutes.
guides.editBodyHint: The format is checked before saving; anything the page cannot draw is pointed out.
guides.publishBody: "{title}" shows on the site at once and you are recorded as its reviewer.
guides.unpublishTitle: Take this guide off the site?
guides.unpublishBody: "{title}" disappears from the site at once. It stays here and can be published again.
